subject.title: fix(oauth): pass workspace context to resolveProviderIdForAuth on refresh failure

question: Should this PR carry the literal `models.json` apiKey precedence change, or should that behavior remain in the separate auth-precedence PR?
rationale: The literal fast path is a broader auth-provider precedence decision that can change existing credential selection and is already proposed separately with its own tests in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100839.

options.title: Keep This PR Narrow
options.body: Remove the literal fast path from this PR and land only the workspace-context propagation once proof is supplied.

options.title: Combine The Precedence Change
options.body: Allow this PR to carry the literal precedence change only after reviewing it as intentional auth-provider policy with focused tests and proof.

options.title: Split Or Supersede
options.body: Ask for separate branches so the OAuth cleanup and literal precedence proposal can be reviewed and landed independently.

recommendation.title: Keep This PR Narrow
recommendation.body: Remove the literal fast path from this PR and land only the workspace-context propagation once proof is supplied.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the clearest current-main routing owner for both the OAuth cleanup line and the per-entry auth precedence block.
